title: Invite people to a room by @handle from a bar in the room, with suggestions, and they are told in Social

tasks.title: Invitations, people search and the room_invite notification on the server
The invite bar in the room and the invitation in activity

acs.text: WHEN a member of a room sends `POST /api/v1/rooms/{roomId}/invites` with `{to: [...]}` (1–20 entries, each at most 320 characters) THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 with one result per entry, in order: `invited` for a handle of a person who is not yet a member, `member` for one who already is, `self` for the caller's own handle, `not_found` for an unknown handle, `invalid` for an entry that is neither a handle nor an email address; a caller who is not a member, or an unknown room, answers 404 `room.not_found`; more than 20 entries, or none, answers 400

WHEN a person is invited THE SYSTEM SHALL add a `room_invite` notification for them naming who invited them and the room's title, once per room and person in 24 hours however often they are invited; the activity page says "<name> invited you to <room>" with a Join button that opens the room's lobby, and the invitation shows as unread like the others
WHEN a caller has invited 50 people in the last hour THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse more with 429 `invite.rate_limited` and a `retry-after` header

WHEN a signed-in viewer sends `GET /api/v1/people?q=` with 1–30 characters THE SYSTEM SHALL answer up to 8 person profiles whose handle starts with the text (a leading `@` ignored) or whose name contains it, each with only id, handle, name and kind, handles that start with it first

WHILE a member is in the room's lobby THE SYSTEM SHALL show, under Invite people, a field labelled "Invite by @handle or email" where typing offers matching people (name and @handle, chosen with the arrow keys and Enter or by a click), Enter, comma or space turns the text into a chip, each chip can be removed, and Send invites sends them and then says, beside each entry, what happened; an entry that failed stays as a chip marked with its reason
